question: Berapa jumlah resep yang tersedia untuk tiap kategori masakan? Tampilkan kategori masakan dan total resepnya.
generated_sql: SELECT m.kategori, COUNT(r.id_resep) AS total_resep FROM masakan m JOIN resep r ON m.kode_masakan = r.kode_masakan GROUP BY m.kategori;
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT m.kategori, COUNT(r.id_resep) AS total_resep
FROM masakan AS m
JOIN resep AS r ON m.kode_masakan = r.kode_masakan
GROUP BY m.kategori;

question: Hitung rata-rata waktu memasak untuk setiap tingkat kesulitan resep. Tampilkan tingkat kesulitan dan rata-ratanya (dalam menit).

question: Tampilkan lima bahan yang paling sering dipakai di semua resep—urutkan dari yang terbanyak. Sertakan nama bahan dan berapa kali dipakai.
generated_sql: SELECT b.nama_bahan, COUNT(rb.id_bahan) AS jumlah_pemakaian FROM bahan b JOIN resep_bahan rb ON b.id_bahan = rb.id_bahan GROUP BY b.nama_bahan ORDER BY jumlah_pemakaian DESC LIMIT 5;
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT b.nama_bahan, COUNT(rb.id_resep) AS frekuensi
FROM bahan AS b
JOIN resep_bahan AS rb ON b.id_bahan = rb.id_bahan
GROUP BY b.id_bahan, b.nama_bahan
ORDER BY frekuensi DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Untuk setiap daerah asal, berapa banyak bahan unik yang digunakan di seluruh masakan daerah tersebut? Tampilkan nama daerah dan jumlah bahan uniknya.
generated_sql: SELECT m.asal_daerah, COUNT(DISTINCT rb.id_bahan) AS jumlah_bahan_unik FROM masakan m JOIN resep_bahan rb ON m.kode_masakan = rb.id_resep GROUP BY m.asal_daerah;
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT m.asal_daerah, COUNT(DISTINCT rb.id_bahan) AS jumlah_bahan
FROM masakan AS m
JOIN resep AS r ON m.kode_masakan = r.kode_masakan
JOIN resep_bahan AS rb ON r.id_resep = rb.id_resep
GROUP BY m.asal_daerah;

question: Bahan apa saja yang muncul lebih sering dibanding rata-rata frekuensi kemunculan semua bahan? Tampilkan nama bahan dan jumlah kemunculannya.
generated_sql:
SELECT b.nama_bahan, COUNT(rb.id_bahan) AS jumlah_kemunculan
FROM bahan b
JOIN resep_bahan rb ON b.id_bahan = rb.id_bahan
GROUP BY b.id_bahan, b.nama_bahan
HAVING COUNT(rb.id_bahan) > (
    SELECT AVG(jumlah_kemunculan)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(id_bahan) AS jumlah_kemunculan
        FROM resep_bahan
        GROUP BY id_bahan
    ) AS subquery_rata_rata
);
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT b.nama_bahan, COUNT(rb.id_resep) AS frekuensi
FROM bahan AS b
JOIN resep_bahan AS rb ON b.id_bahan = rb.id_bahan
GROUP BY b.id_bahan, b.nama_bahan
HAVING COUNT(rb.id_resep) > (
  SELECT AVG(cnt)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM resep_bahan
    GROUP BY id_bahan
  ) AS sub
);

question: Daerah asal mana yang memiliki jumlah masakan di bawah rata-rata jumlah masakan per daerah? Tampilkan nama daerah dan total masakannya.
generated_sql:
SELECT asal_daerah, COUNT(*) AS total_masakan
FROM masakan
GROUP BY asal_daerah
HAVING COUNT(*) < (SELECT AVG(jumlah_masakan) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS jumlah_masakan FROM masakan GROUP BY asal_daerah) AS subquery);
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT asal_daerah, COUNT(*) AS total_masakan
FROM masakan
GROUP BY asal_daerah
HAVING COUNT(*) < (
  SELECT AVG(jml)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS jml
    FROM masakan
    GROUP BY asal_daerah
  ) AS sub
);

question: Resep mana yang durasi memasaknya lebih singkat daripada resep 'Rendang'? Tampilkan judul resep dan durasinya.

ground_truth_sql:
SELECT r.judul_resep, r.waktu_masak
FROM resep AS r
JOIN masakan AS m ON r.kode_masakan = m.kode_masakan
WHERE r.waktu_masak < (
  SELECT r2.waktu_masak
  FROM resep AS r2
  JOIN masakan AS m2 ON r2.kode_masakan = m2.kode_masakan

question: Sebutkan nama masakan yang memakai lebih banyak bahan daripada rata-rata jumlah bahan semua masakan.

question: Masakan asal mana yang menggunakan setidaknya satu bahan yang tidak pernah dipakai masakan asal 'Bali'? Tampilkan nama daerahnya saja.
generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.asal_daerah FROM masakan m JOIN resep r ON m.kode_masakan = r.kode_masakan JOIN bahan_resep br ON r.kode_resep = br.kode_resep WHERE br.kode_bahan NOT IN (SELECT br2.kode_bahan FROM masakan m2 JOIN resep r2 ON m2.kode_masakan = r2.kode_masakan JOIN bahan_resep br2 ON r2.kode_resep = br2.kode_resep WHERE m2.asal_daerah = 'Bali') AND m.asal_daerah != 'Bali';
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.asal_daerah
FROM masakan AS m
JOIN resep AS r ON m.kode_masakan = r.kode_masakan
JOIN resep_bahan AS rb ON r.id_resep = rb.id_resep
WHERE rb.id_bahan NOT IN (
  SELECT rb2.id_bahan
  FROM masakan AS m2
  JOIN resep AS r2 ON m2.kode_masakan = r2.kode_masakan
  JOIN resep_bahan AS rb2 ON r2.id_resep = rb2.id_resep
  WHERE m2.asal_daerah = 'Bali'
);

question: Berapa banyak resep yang tidak menggunakan bahan apa pun yang mengandung kata 'Cabe'? Tampilkan jumlahnya saja.
generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id_resep)
FROM resep r
LEFT JOIN resep_bahan rb ON r.id_resep = rb.id_resep
LEFT JOIN bahan b ON rb.id_bahan = b.id_bahan
WHERE r.id_resep NOT IN (
    SELECT rb_inner.id_resep
    FROM resep_bahan rb_inner
    JOIN bahan b_inner ON rb_inner.id_bahan = b_inner.id_bahan
    WHERE b_inner.nama_bahan LIKE '%Cabe%'
);
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS resep_tanpa_cabe
FROM resep AS r
WHERE r.id_resep NOT IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT rb.id_resep
  FROM resep_bahan AS rb
  JOIN bahan AS b ON rb.id_bahan = b.id_bahan
  WHERE b.nama_bahan LIKE '%Cabe%'
);
